objective.name: mailbox.ack
objective.description: Acknowledges a mailbox message successfully consumed by its owning run and removes its mailbox entry while preserving the durable continuity message.

#root.role: Finalize successful mailbox consumption by verifying ownership and removing the claimed entry through one guarded mailbox write, without altering durable message history.

effects.mailbox: Removes exactly one claimed mailbox entry owned by the requesting run.

transformation_contract.morphing: A successfully consumed claimed mailbox entry becomes absent from the mailbox while its durable message remains part of continuity history.
invariants: Only the run owning the claimed entry may acknowledge it.
A pending entry cannot be acknowledged.
Acknowledgement removes mailbox consumption state only.
The durable message referenced by message_id is never deleted or mutated.
An acknowledged message cannot later be reinserted with the same message id.
Acknowledgement produces no replay, wake, or cognitive effect.

Mutations of the Matters of one continuity are serialized by short critical-section locks keyed by continuity_id inside the agentic_core wrapper process: a lock is held only around a read, recompute and guarded write, never during an LLM inference, an external invoke or a wait; it is never the sole guarantee.
Every write to a mutable Matter carries expected_revision; a revision conflict causes a bounded read, recompute and retry.
Revision is opaque concurrency metadata and is never used as an application sequence.
The operation mutates a single Matter through one matter.write guarded by expected_revision, and is atomic at the engine level for that Matter only.
success: The targeted entry is verified as claimed by run_id.
The mailbox entry is removed by one mailbox write guarded by expected_revision.
The durable message remains untouched in the journal.
failure: Fails if the mailbox does not belong to continuity_id.
Fails if the entry does not exist according to the chosen technical not-found policy.
Fails if the entry is pending.
Fails if claimed_by differs from run_id.
Fails explicitly with a concurrency failure when the bounded retries on revision conflict are exhausted.
notes: Executed by the agentic_core Python wrapper.
mailbox.ack delegates no architectural behavior to another capacity.
Clearing runtime.current_message_id belongs to pilot.activate after acknowledgement succeeds.
The implementation may report an already-acknowledged condition idempotently, but it must never recreate the entry.
The concurrency model of agentic_core is defined once in the document agentic_core_concurrency_model.

#resolve_state.role: Derive the three Matters owned by the target continuity from continuity_id.

failure: Fails if one of the three derived Matters does not exist.
invariants: Matter IDs follow the convention continuity_<id> (header), journal_<id>, mailbox_<id>, runtime_<id>.
Resolution is deterministic and requires no caller-provided Matter.
transformation_contract.morphing: A continuity_id becomes the physical Matter IDs of its continuity, mailbox, and runtime.

#locate.role: Resolve the mailbox entry targeted by message_id.

invariants: The lookup does not mutate mailbox state.
transformation_contract.morphing: A mailbox message identifier becomes its current mailbox entry or an explicit absence result.

#authorize.role: Verify that the entry is currently claimed and owned by the requesting run.

failure: Pending, unowned, or differently owned entries reject acknowledgement.
transformation_contract.morphing: A claimed mailbox entry and run identity become an authorized or rejected acknowledgement request.
success: Only the current consumption owner may proceed.

#remove_entry.role: Remove the authorized mailbox entry through one guarded mailbox write.

failure: If the guarded write cannot be completed, the entry remains claimed and intact.
invariants: Removal is one mailbox write guarded by expected_revision; on conflict the mailbox is re-read and ownership re-verified.
No other mailbox entry is modified.
No durable continuity message is modified.
transformation_contract.morphing: An authorized claimed mailbox entry becomes permanently absent from active mailbox consumption state.
success: The entry is no longer present in mailbox.entries.
